purpose.zh: 根基因 ID 到中英文名称的唯一登记表。思维雷达的第一根轴用它显示名称，元数据校验器用它检查游戏声明的 ID 是否存在。ID 只描述能力，位置信息一律走 moduleId / unitId / levelId。
purpose.en: The single registry mapping rootGene ids to bilingual names. Axis 1 of the thinking radar uses it for labels, and the metadata validator uses it to check that ids declared by games actually exist. An id describes ABILITY only; location always travels in moduleId / unitId / levelId.

notes.namingZh: 格式 RG.SCOPE.CATEGORY.NODE，全大写，段内用下划线。
notes.namingEn: Format RG.SCOPE.CATEGORY.NODE, upper case, underscores inside a segment.
notes.unknownZh: 未登记的 ID 不是错误：radar-reader.js 会从 ID 本身推导出显示名，图表当天就能显示；登记只是为了给它一个人话名字。
notes.unknownEn: An unregistered id is not an error: radar-reader.js derives a label from the id itself, so a brand-new gene charts the day it is first reported. Registering it only gives it a human name.
notes.mnZh: 根基因与模块是 M:N 关系。同一个基因可以被多个模块训练，同一个模块也可以声明多个基因。
notes.statusZh: status 缺省为 active。planned 表示这个基因已经被 metadata/game.json 认领，但还没有任何代码上报过它，校验器把它报成 INFO 而不是「死条目」警告。
notes.statusEn: status defaults to active. planned means the gene is already claimed by metadata/game.json but no code reports it yet, so the validator lists it as INFO instead of warning about a dead entry.

RG.LOGIC.COMPARISON.BASIC.descZh: 在共同维度上判断两个或多个对象的大小、多少、顺序与等同。
RG.LOGIC.COMPARISON.BASIC.descEn: Judge relation, order and equivalence among objects on a shared dimension.

RG.LOGIC.REASONING.BASIC.descZh: 由已知条件推出未知结论，包括传递关系与排除法。
RG.LOGIC.REASONING.BASIC.descEn: Derive an unknown conclusion from given facts, including transitivity and elimination.

RG.PATTERN.SEQUENCE.BASIC.descZh: 发现一串元素的重复或递进规则，并据此续写。
RG.PATTERN.SEQUENCE.BASIC.descEn: Find the repeating or progressing rule in a run of elements and continue it.

RG.PATTERN.VISUAL.SIZE.descZh: 以尺寸为线索识别视觉规律。
RG.PATTERN.VISUAL.SIZE.descEn: Read a visual pattern whose cue is size.

RG.PATTERN.VISUAL.COLOR.descZh: 以颜色为线索识别视觉规律。
RG.PATTERN.VISUAL.COLOR.descEn: Read a visual pattern whose cue is color.

RG.PATTERN.VISUAL.SEQUENCE.descZh: 在图形排列中识别顺序规律。
RG.PATTERN.VISUAL.SEQUENCE.descEn: Identify order in an arrangement of shapes.

RG.PATTERN.SPATIAL.RELATION.descZh: 判断上下、左右、内外、相邻等位置关系。
RG.PATTERN.SPATIAL.RELATION.descEn: Judge above/below, left/right, inside/outside and adjacency.

RG.PATTERN.TEMPORAL.SEQUENCE.descZh: 判断事件的先后顺序与因果链条。
RG.PATTERN.TEMPORAL.SEQUENCE.descEn: Order events in time and follow a chain of causes.

RG.PATTERN.MOTION.SEQUENCE.descZh: 从移动、旋转、翻转中提取变化规则。
RG.PATTERN.MOTION.SEQUENCE.descEn: Extract the rule behind movement, rotation or flipping.

RG.PATTERN.QUANTITY.RELATION.descZh: 识别数量之间的增减、倍数与对应关系。
RG.PATTERN.QUANTITY.RELATION.descEn: Recognise increase, multiple and correspondence between quantities.

RG.PATTERN.INTEGRATION.MULTI_DIMENSION.descZh: 同时跟踪两条以上线索，并把它们合起来判断。
RG.PATTERN.INTEGRATION.MULTI_DIMENSION.descEn: Track two or more cues at once and combine them into one judgement.

RG.PATTERN.TRANSFORMATION.RULE.descZh: 看出前一个对象是怎么变成后一个的，并把这条变换用下去：部件增减、组合拆分、属性逐步改变。
RG.PATTERN.TRANSFORMATION.RULE.descEn: See how each object becomes the next one and apply that transformation onward: parts added or removed, assembly and splitting, an attribute changing step by step.
RG.PATTERN.TRANSFORMATION.RULE.boundaryZh: 单符号的朝向旋转（↑→↓←）归小精灵 Visual Pattern，方向加步长的连续移动归 Motion Pattern；本基因只管可数的部件与属性变化。
RG.PATTERN.TRANSFORMATION.RULE.boundaryEn: Rotating a single symbol's heading is MindSeeds Visual Pattern and direction-plus-step movement is Motion Pattern; this gene covers only countable part and attribute changes.

RG.MATH.NUMBER_SENSE.BASIC.descZh: 对数的大小、多少与相对位置形成直觉。
RG.MATH.NUMBER_SENSE.BASIC.descEn: Build intuition for magnitude, quantity and relative position of numbers.

RG.MATH.NUMBER_SENSE.QUANTITY.descZh: 不数数就能感知一堆物体大约有多少，并粗略判断哪边更多。
RG.MATH.NUMBER_SENSE.QUANTITY.descEn: Sense roughly how many objects are in a group without counting, and judge which side has more.
RG.MATH.NUMBER_SENSE.QUANTITY.boundaryZh: 与 RG.LOGIC.COMPARISON.BASIC 的界限：Comparison 训练的是比较判断本身（在已知两个量的前提下如何判断关系），本基因训练的是对量本身的内部感觉（一眼估出大约几个），不要求先有清楚的两个数才能比。
RG.MATH.NUMBER_SENSE.QUANTITY.boundaryEn: Boundary with RG.LOGIC.COMPARISON.BASIC: Comparison trains the act of judging a relation once two quantities are already known; this gene trains the felt sense of a quantity itself (glancing at a group and sensing roughly how many), and does not require two clean numbers to already be in hand.

RG.MATH.NUMBER_SENSE.PART_WHOLE.descZh: 看出一个整体是由哪些部分组成的，以及部分之间如何拼回整体。
RG.MATH.NUMBER_SENSE.PART_WHOLE.descEn: See which parts make up a whole, and how those parts fit back together into it.
RG.MATH.NUMBER_SENSE.PART_WHOLE.boundaryZh: 与 RG.MATH.NUMBER_SENSE.COMPOSITION 的界限：本基因训练的是识别一份已给出的整体-部分关系是否成立，COMPOSITION 训练的是主动列举一个数有哪些不同的拆分方式。
RG.MATH.NUMBER_SENSE.PART_WHOLE.boundaryEn: Boundary with RG.MATH.NUMBER_SENSE.COMPOSITION: this gene trains recognising whether a given whole-part relation holds; COMPOSITION trains actively generating the different ways a number can be split.

RG.MATH.NUMBER_SENSE.COMPOSITION.descZh: 主动列举一个数可以拆成哪些不同的两份或多份，并判断拆法是否成立。
RG.MATH.NUMBER_SENSE.COMPOSITION.descEn: Actively generate the different ways a number can be split into two or more parts, and judge whether a proposed split is valid.
RG.MATH.NUMBER_SENSE.COMPOSITION.boundaryZh: 与 RG.MATH.NUMBER_SENSE.PART_WHOLE 的界限见该条目。
RG.MATH.NUMBER_SENSE.COMPOSITION.boundaryEn: See RG.MATH.NUMBER_SENSE.PART_WHOLE for the boundary between the two.

RG.STRATEGY.DECISION.PLANNING.descZh: 在多个可行方案中权衡取舍，并安排先后步骤。
RG.STRATEGY.DECISION.PLANNING.descEn: Weigh several workable options and order the steps between them.

RG.MODELING.EQUATION.RELATION.descZh: 把一个具体情境写成可计算的关系式。
RG.MODELING.EQUATION.RELATION.descEn: Turn a concrete situation into a relation that can be computed.

RG.MODELING.MAPPING.BASIC.descZh: 用一个简化的符号、图形或标签代表一个具体事物或角色，并能从符号还原出所指的对象。
RG.MODELING.MAPPING.BASIC.descEn: Use a simplified symbol, picture or label to stand for a concrete thing or role, and read back what a symbol stands for.
RG.MODELING.MAPPING.BASIC.boundaryZh: 与 RG.PATTERN.SEQUENCE.BASIC 等规律基因的界限：那些基因训练「下一个是什么」的续写与预测，本基因训练「这个符号代表谁」的双向对应，不涉及续写或规律预测。
RG.MODELING.MAPPING.BASIC.boundaryEn: Boundary with pattern genes such as RG.PATTERN.SEQUENCE.BASIC: those train continuing/predicting a sequence, while this gene trains bidirectional correspondence between a symbol and what it stands for, with no continuation involved.

RG.MODELING.GROUPING.PURPOSE.descZh: 同一组对象按不同目的可以有不同的合理分组，练习为给定目的选出正确的分组标准并归类。
RG.MODELING.GROUPING.PURPOSE.descEn: The same set of objects can be grouped differently depending on purpose; practice choosing the grouping criterion that fits a stated purpose and sorting accordingly.
RG.MODELING.GROUPING.PURPOSE.boundaryZh: 与 RG.LOGIC.CLASSIFICATION.BASIC 的界限：Classification 训练按物体固有属性归入唯一正确的组别；本基因训练同一组对象在不同目的下可以有不同的、都合理的分组标准，模型本身随目的变化，不存在单一「正确答案」的属性归类。
RG.MODELING.GROUPING.PURPOSE.boundaryEn: Boundary with RG.LOGIC.CLASSIFICATION.BASIC: Classification trains sorting objects into a single correct group by an inherent attribute; this gene trains that the same objects can have different, equally valid groupings depending on stated purpose — the model itself shifts with purpose, not a fixed-attribute sort.

RG.MODELING.SPATIAL.BASIC.descZh: 把真实的空间关系（位置、路径、方位）转换成简化的示意图或地图来阅读和使用。
RG.MODELING.SPATIAL.BASIC.descEn: Turn real spatial relations (position, path, direction) into a simplified diagram or map, and read or use that diagram.
RG.MODELING.SPATIAL.BASIC.boundaryZh: 与 RG.PATTERN.SPATIAL.RELATION 的界限：那条基因训练直接判断上下左右等位置关系本身；本基因训练把这些关系抽象成一张简化示意图/地图，并能反过来用这张图回答问题——多一层「建模」的转换，不是位置关系判断本身。
RG.MODELING.SPATIAL.BASIC.boundaryEn: Boundary with RG.PATTERN.SPATIAL.RELATION: that gene trains directly judging positional relations themselves; this gene trains abstracting those relations into a simplified diagram/map and using it to answer questions — an added layer of modeling, not the raw relational judgment.

RG.LOGIC.CLASSIFICATION.BASIC.descZh: 按一条或多条属性把对象归入正确的组别。
RG.LOGIC.CLASSIFICATION.BASIC.descEn: Put objects into the right group by one or more attributes.

RG.ATTENTION.SEARCH.VISUAL.descZh: 在干扰项中持续寻找并确认目标，数量未知时也不放弃。
RG.ATTENTION.SEARCH.VISUAL.descEn: Keep locating and confirming targets among distractors, even when the count is unknown.
RG.ATTENTION.SEARCH.VISUAL.boundaryZh: 两个认领者分工不同，不是重复建设：find-it 在开放场景里找若干个目标（数量未知），difference-scout 在成对条带里找恰好一个（位置未知）。
RG.ATTENTION.SEARCH.VISUAL.boundaryEn: The two claimants split the work rather than duplicating it: find-it searches an open scene for an unknown number of targets, while difference-scout searches paired strips for exactly one, at an unknown position.

RG.LANGUAGE.SEMANTIC.RELATION.descZh: 判断词与词之间的相同、同义与反义关系。
RG.LANGUAGE.SEMANTIC.RELATION.descEn: Judge sameness, synonymy and antonymy between words.

RG.LANGUAGE.OBSERVATION.DESCRIBE.descZh: 在一段具体的文本或画面里发现细节，并判断哪个细节对理解最重要、暗示了什么。
RG.LANGUAGE.OBSERVATION.DESCRIBE.descEn: Notice details in a specific text or picture, and judge which detail matters most for understanding and what it suggests.
RG.LANGUAGE.OBSERVATION.DESCRIBE.boundaryZh: 与 RG.SCIENCE.OBSERVATION.BASIC 的界限：科学观察记录真实现象，为因果推理服务；本基因的细节只存在于这一段素材里，不读素材答不出来。
RG.LANGUAGE.OBSERVATION.DESCRIBE.boundaryEn: Boundary with RG.SCIENCE.OBSERVATION.BASIC: science observation records real phenomena to support causal reasoning; here the details exist only in this passage, so the question cannot be answered without reading it.

RG.LANGUAGE.COMPREHENSION.INFO.descZh: 理解文本明确说了什么，并区分主要内容和次要细节。
RG.LANGUAGE.COMPREHENSION.INFO.descEn: Understand what a text states, and tell the main point apart from minor details.
RG.LANGUAGE.COMPREHENSION.INFO.boundaryZh: 与 RG.LANGUAGE.INFERENCE.EVIDENCE 的界限：信息理解的答案在原文里可以直接找到或直接概括出来；推理的答案原文没有直说。
RG.LANGUAGE.COMPREHENSION.INFO.boundaryEn: Boundary with RG.LANGUAGE.INFERENCE.EVIDENCE: in comprehension the answer is stated or can be summarised directly from the text; in inference the text never says it outright.

RG.LANGUAGE.INFERENCE.EVIDENCE.descZh: 从文本线索推出没有直接说出的信息（心情、原因、接下来会发生什么），并能回到原文指出依据。
RG.LANGUAGE.INFERENCE.EVIDENCE.descEn: Work out what the text does not state (feelings, causes, what happens next) from its clues, and point back to the evidence in the text.
RG.LANGUAGE.INFERENCE.EVIDENCE.boundaryZh: 与 RG.LOGIC.REASONING.BASIC 的界限：逻辑推理的前提是抽象给定的规则；本基因的前提是叙事语言本身（动作、神态、用词），并且必须回到文本找证据。
RG.LANGUAGE.INFERENCE.EVIDENCE.boundaryEn: Boundary with RG.LOGIC.REASONING.BASIC: logic reasoning starts from abstract given rules; this gene starts from narrative language itself (actions, expressions, wording) and must point back to evidence in the text.

RG.LANGUAGE.STRUCTURE.SEQUENCE.descZh: 依据文本里的顺序信号（时间词、因果连接）重建事件的先后，认识开头、经过、结尾，并区分“写的顺序”和“发生的顺序”。
RG.LANGUAGE.STRUCTURE.SEQUENCE.descEn: Rebuild the order of events from the text's own signals (time words, cause-and-effect links), recognise beginning, middle and end, and tell the order of telling apart from the order of events.
RG.LANGUAGE.STRUCTURE.SEQUENCE.boundaryZh: 与 RG.PATTERN.SEQUENCE.BASIC 的界限：规律序列延续一条可见的规则；本基因的顺序只能从这篇文本的语言信号里得出，不能只靠生活常识。
RG.LANGUAGE.STRUCTURE.SEQUENCE.boundaryEn: Boundary with RG.PATTERN.SEQUENCE.BASIC: a pattern sequence extends a visible rule; here the order can only come from this text's language signals, not from general common sense.

RG.LANGUAGE.CHOICE.CONTEXT.descZh: 比较不同的词语或说法放在具体语境里的效果，判断哪个更准确、更生动、更适合场合，并说出理由。
RG.LANGUAGE.CHOICE.CONTEXT.descEn: Compare how different words or phrasings work in a specific context, judge which is more precise, vivid or appropriate, and say why.
RG.LANGUAGE.CHOICE.CONTEXT.boundaryZh: 与 RG.LANGUAGE.SEMANTIC.RELATION 的界限：词义关系判断词与词之间的关系；本基因判断词与语境是否相配。
RG.LANGUAGE.CHOICE.CONTEXT.boundaryEn: Boundary with RG.LANGUAGE.SEMANTIC.RELATION: semantic relation judges how two words relate to each other; this gene judges how well a word fits its context.

RG.LANGUAGE.EXPRESSION.GUIDED.descZh: 在读过的故事基础上，用给定的表达要素组织自己的想法（续编、换角色想），再对照他人的不同角度进行反思，没有唯一正确答案。
RG.LANGUAGE.EXPRESSION.GUIDED.descEn: Building on a story just read, organise one's own idea from given building blocks (continue it, or think as another character), then reflect on it against others' different viewpoints; there is no single right answer.
RG.LANGUAGE.EXPRESSION.GUIDED.boundaryZh: 与 RG.LANGUAGE.SEMANTIC.RELATION 的界限：词义关系有对错判定；本基因不判对错，训练的是组织表达并从他人视角反思。
RG.LANGUAGE.EXPRESSION.GUIDED.boundaryEn: Boundary with RG.LANGUAGE.SEMANTIC.RELATION: semantic relation is judged right or wrong; this gene is never judged, and trains organising an idea and reflecting from others' viewpoints.

RG.SCIENCE.OBSERVATION.BASIC.descZh: 有系统地记录一个现象的特征与细节，为后续推理提供依据，而不只是「看一看」。
RG.SCIENCE.OBSERVATION.BASIC.descEn: Systematically record the features and details of a phenomenon to support later reasoning, rather than merely looking.
RG.SCIENCE.OBSERVATION.BASIC.boundaryZh: 与 RG.ATTENTION.SEARCH.VISUAL 的界限：视觉搜索训练的是在干扰项中找到并确认一个目标；本基因训练的是记录一个现象本身有哪些特征细节以供推理，不是「找目标」。
RG.SCIENCE.OBSERVATION.BASIC.boundaryEn: Boundary with RG.ATTENTION.SEARCH.VISUAL: visual search trains finding and confirming a target among distractors; this gene trains recording the features and details of a phenomenon itself for later reasoning, not locating a target.

RG.SCIENCE.QUESTIONING.BASIC.descZh: 从观察到的现象中提出一个可以被检验的问题：找出尚不清楚的地方，并把它表述成可以去调查的形式。
RG.SCIENCE.QUESTIONING.BASIC.descEn: Form a testable question from an observed phenomenon: identify what is not yet known and frame it as something that can be investigated.
RG.SCIENCE.QUESTIONING.BASIC.boundaryZh: 与 RG.SCIENCE.OBSERVATION.BASIC 的界限：观察记录的是现象「是什么」，本基因训练的是找出现象里「还不知道什么」，并把它转成一个可检验的问题，二者方向相反、缺一不可。
RG.SCIENCE.QUESTIONING.BASIC.boundaryEn: Boundary with RG.SCIENCE.OBSERVATION.BASIC: observation records what a phenomenon IS, while this gene trains identifying what is NOT yet known about it and turning that gap into a testable question — the two point in opposite but complementary directions.

RG.SCIENCE.PREDICTION.BASIC.descZh: 在实验或行动发生之前，依据一个假设说出预期会发生的结果，以便日后与实际结果对照检验。
RG.SCIENCE.PREDICTION.BASIC.descEn: State an expected outcome before an experiment or action takes place, based on a hypothesis, so it can later be checked against the actual result.
RG.SCIENCE.PREDICTION.BASIC.boundaryZh: 与 RG.PATTERN.SEQUENCE.BASIC 的界限：序列规律训练的是延续一条已经看得见的重复或递进规则；本基因训练的是在行动或实验发生之前，依据因果假设说出预期结果，续写的对象是不可见的未来结果，不是一条已展示的序列。
RG.SCIENCE.PREDICTION.BASIC.boundaryEn: Boundary with RG.PATTERN.SEQUENCE.BASIC: pattern sequence trains continuing an already-visible repeating or progressing rule; this gene trains stating an expected outcome of an action or experiment before it happens, based on a hypothesis about cause and effect — not extending a rule that is already on display.

RG.SCIENCE.EXPERIMENTATION.BASIC.descZh: 设计一个公平的检验：决定要改变哪一个变量、保持哪些条件不变，以此来检验一个假设。
RG.SCIENCE.EXPERIMENTATION.BASIC.descEn: Design a fair test by deciding which variable to change and which conditions to keep the same, in order to check a hypothesis.
RG.SCIENCE.EXPERIMENTATION.BASIC.boundaryZh: 与 RG.STRATEGY.DECISION.PLANNING 的界限：决策规划训练的是在多个可行方案中权衡取舍并安排先后步骤以达成目标；本基因训练的是为了检验一个因果假设而专门分离并控制变量，这里的目标特指因果检验，不是一般性的方案规划。
RG.SCIENCE.EXPERIMENTATION.BASIC.boundaryEn: Boundary with RG.STRATEGY.DECISION.PLANNING: decision planning trains weighing options and ordering steps to reach a goal; this gene trains isolating and controlling variables specifically to test a hypothesis — the goal here is causal testing, not general planning.

RG.SCIENCE.EVIDENCE.BASIC.descZh: 判断观察到的数据是否足够、是否相关，能否支持或推翻一个结论。
RG.SCIENCE.EVIDENCE.BASIC.descEn: Judge whether observed data is sufficient and relevant enough to support or refute a conclusion.
RG.SCIENCE.EVIDENCE.BASIC.boundaryZh: 与 RG.LOGIC.COMPARISON.BASIC 的界限：比较判断的是两个已知对象或数量之间的关系；本基因判断的是一整批数据是否足够有力去支持某个给定的结论，是对「支持力度是否充分」的判断，不是对数值关系的判断。
RG.SCIENCE.EVIDENCE.BASIC.boundaryEn: Boundary with RG.LOGIC.COMPARISON.BASIC: comparison judges the relation between two known objects or quantities; this gene judges whether a body of data is strong or sufficient enough to support a given conclusion — a different kind of judgment about sufficiency of support, not about the relation between values.

RG.SCIENCE.EXPLANATION.BASIC.descZh: 构建一条把证据与结论连接起来的因果说明（为什么会发生），并在出现新证据时可以修正。
RG.SCIENCE.EXPLANATION.BASIC.descEn: Construct a causal account that connects evidence to a conclusion (why something happened), revisable when new evidence appears.
RG.SCIENCE.EXPLANATION.BASIC.boundaryZh: 与 RG.LANGUAGE.SEMANTIC.RELATION 的界限：语言/词义基因关心的是词义本身的机制与词与词之间的关系；本基因关心的是连接证据与结论的因果链条是否成立，语言只是承载因果说明的载体，不是被训练的对象。
RG.SCIENCE.EXPLANATION.BASIC.boundaryEn: Boundary with RG.LANGUAGE.SEMANTIC.RELATION: language/semantic genes are about the mechanics of word meaning and relations between words; this gene is about whether the causal chain linking evidence to a conclusion actually holds together — language is only the carrier of the explanation, not what is being trained.
